description: MainActivity class for an Android app, managing navigation, intent handling, UI setup, and interactions with backend and preferences.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing navigation, intent processing, UI setup, and interactions with backend and preferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up navigation, UI insets, drawer header, and handles initial intent.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received by the activity.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Custom back button behavior, closes drawer or pops back stack.

methods.name: copySharedMedia
methods.description: Copies media from a URI to app's private storage.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents for sharing media, creating or opening notes.

methods.name: getDeepLink
methods.description: Creates a deep link intent for navigation.

methods.name: setupDrawerHeader
methods.description: Initializes drawer header UI and backend info display.

methods.name: selectCurrentDestinationMenuItem
methods.description: Highlights the current menu item based on navigation destination.

methods.name: setupDrawerMenuItems
methods.description: Sets click listeners for drawer menu items.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Configures navigation controller, drawer, and notebook menu items.
